data.title: Desonide 0.05% cream/lotion
data.summary: IV Topical corticosteroids · Low-potency non-fluorinated topical steroid (US class 6)
data.body:
_Topicals · IV Topical corticosteroids_

**Class:** Low-potency non-fluorinated topical steroid (US class 6)

## Mechanism of action
- Glucocorticoid receptor agonist; low atrophy risk

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Atopic dermatitis and seborrhoeic dermatitis of face and flexures, children (approved from 3 months)
- Mild eczema in sensitive areas

## Dose & formulations
- Thin layer twice daily; usually up to 4 weeks

## Adverse effects
- Burning, mild atrophy with long use; perioral dermatitis

## Contraindications
- Untreated infections, rosacea, perioral dermatitis

## Pregnancy & lactation
Acceptable (low potency).

## Viva points
- Low potency, non-fluorinated — suitable for face and children
- Belongs to the acetonide group (class B contact allergy)

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.45; Khopkar ch.22. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
